item.title: Software Developer · IDEEZA
item.description: At IDEEZA, I go beyond conventional front-end work. My expertise spans the full software engineering spectrum, with a focus on integrating software with hardware. I develop custom Blockly blocks tailored for Arduino and Raspberry Pi, lead the creation of a versatile no-code APK generator capable of seamless communication via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, and actively contribute to backend development and architectural decisions.

item.title: Software Developer · JoulesLabs
item.description: Started as an intern and rose to lead the entire Frontend team, successfully handling multiple projects simultaneously. I mentored team members, introduced the latest web standards, and implemented optimal technologies. I conducted regular tech sessions, emphasizing conceptual understanding and practical relevance, while developing and maintaining modern Next.js frontends and React Native mobile apps.
